_comment: Tight spine (docs/game-plan.md). One refine step keeps the gather -> refine -> craft chain intact without a tier ladder.

items.name: Water
items.desc: Litre of potable water. The only currency that matters.

items.name: Blood Sack
items.desc: Recovered body water. Needs purifying before it is worth drinking.

items.name: Plant Fibre
items.desc: Tough desert growth. Feedstock for everything woven.

items.name: Salvaged Metal
items.desc: Stripped from wrecks. The basis of every fabricated part.

items.name: Granite Stone
items.desc: Quarried from outcrops. Bulk building material.

items.name: Cutteray
items.desc: Cutting beam. Harvests ore and strips wrecks.

items.name: Dew Harvester
items.desc: Draws moisture from plants. Works dusk to dawn only.

items.name: Stillsuit
items.desc: Reclaims body moisture. Cuts water loss substantially.

items.name: Kindjal
items.desc: Short blade. Slow enough to pass a shield.

items.name: Iron Ore
items.desc: Raw vein rock. Worthless until refined.

items.name: Steel Ingot
items.desc: Refined from ore. The backbone of every fabricated part.

items.name: Fibre Weave
items.desc: Spun plant fibre. Holds a seal against the skin.

items.name: Survival Fabricator
items.desc: Portable workbench. Deploy it and it stays put.

items.name: Ore Refinery
items.desc: Cooks ore down to workable metal.
